outcome: Child-reported pictograph Tanner pubic hair staging
cohort: 1485 mother-child pairs enrolled during pregnancy from obstetric practices
finding: Boys born by cesarean delivery developed puberty earlier, evidenced by an earlier age at peak height velocity and earlier attainment of puberty score > 1, than boys born by vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The association between cesarean delivery and earlier pubertal development in boys was similar for planned (no labor) and unplanned (labor) cesarean delivery.
